name: Toad Cudgel
book_effect: A club shaped like a three-quarter-length baseball bat; the System calls it caveman-flavored. Carl never uses it, since fists are better.
desc: A stick with ambitions. The System says it was carved by someone who had only heard of baseball.

name: Fireplace Poker
book_effect: A plain iron poker; a weak melee weapon.
desc: Still warm from somebody's cozy evening, which ended. Technically a weapon.

name: Common Fingerless Gloves
book_effect: A common-quality pair of fingerless gloves; a small defensive bonus.
desc: For the fighter who wants cold knuckles and a sense of style.

name: Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk
book_effect: +3 Strength and +3 Powerful Strike. Carl is furious that it is a toe ring and not shoes.
desc: A ring for your toe. Still no pants, still no shoes. The System is very proud of itself.

name: Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness
book_effect: +4 Constitution, resists poison and ice, resists piercing hits.
desc: Cut from something that used to haunt a cellar. Stout, drafty, and absolutely not pants.

name: Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling
book_effect: +7 Regeneration; shrugs off stun, knockback and disarm.
desc: Hide from a troll that was extremely good at healing. Do not ask about the previous owner.

name: Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces
book_effect: Reflects 10 percent of melee damage, cancels momentum attacks, retractable needle spikes.
desc: Retractable needles for knees. Whoever hits you learns something about sharp edges.
source: Silver Goblin Box after the Hoarder (L2229)

name: War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull
book_effect: +3 Strength, +1 Dexterity, +2 Iron Punch, +1 Powerful Strike, 2 percent stun. After a 2 second clench it forms a spiked orc-steel fist.
desc: A glove that lets your hand do the talking. It says one word and the word is spikes.

name: BigBoi Boxers
book_effect: White with red hearts, +2 Constitution, casts Protective Shell once every 30 hours. Counts as Carl's only pants.
desc: White, with little red hearts. They count as pants in the sense that nothing else does.
source: Boss box after the Krakaren Clone, Floor 2 (L5905)

name: Pedicure Kit of the Sylph
book_effect: Twelve foot-care tools. Grants a bare-foot attack bonus, unbreakable feet and trap warnings; enchantments can only be applied in a safe or personal space.
desc: Twelve tools for foot care. The System takes this very seriously and will not explain why.

name: Shuriken of Bloodlust (x100)
book_effect: One hundred throwing stars; +8 percent compounding damage with every hit, but the stars are fragile.
desc: A hundred tiny reasons to stand farther away. They get meaner as the fight gets longer.

name: Crown of the Sepsis Whore
book_effect: +5 Intelligence, +5 Good First Impression, 15 percent Sepsis; makes the wearer heir to the Blood Sultanate on Floor 9, which is a trap.
desc: A tiara with an ominous name and gems that swirl like storm clouds. Looks great on a cat.

name: Fae Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet
book_effect: +2 Dexterity; a silver scale skirt with a slot for a tail.
desc: A skirt for the four-legged. Fast, shiny, and extremely proud of itself.

name: Talisman of the Slate Butterfly
book_effect: +4 Light on Your Feet, +1 Intelligence; winged fairies stay friendly. Jingles, so it is noisy.
desc: Remember the sad tale of the Slate Butterfly and the fairies will be nice to you. It jingles.

name: Potion of Healing
book_effect: Increases health by at least 50 percent. Does not cure poison or other ongoing health drains.
desc: Tastes like cherry cough syrup and regret. It works anyway.

name: Potion of Mana
book_effect: Restores mana.
desc: Blue, fizzy and legally a beverage. The System asks that you do not mix it with lighter fluid.

name: Poison Antidote
book_effect: Cures poison.
desc: Tastes like pennies. Cures what bit you.

name: Potion of Iron Skin
book_effect: Hardens the skin for a short time (a damage-resist buff).
desc: Your skin goes full hardware store for a few minutes. Itchy, but you will live.

name: Skill Potion
book_effect: Adds one level to a skill; the first one Carl drank unlocked sorting his inventory by value (Determine Value).
desc: One free skill level, courtesy of a corporation that wants you to keep buying things.

name: Cheat Code Potion
book_effect: Short shelf life: it expires soon after it is generated, so it cannot be hoarded.
desc: Drink it now. It will not be there later, like most good ideas.

name: Experience Cookie
book_effect: Gives experience; Donut got +9.8 EXP from one and Carl shared it through the party.
desc: Eat the lessons of strangers. Mostly chocolate chips, mostly lessons about dying.
source: Free at safe rooms, one per crawler per day (L2871)

name: Mana Toast
book_effect: Free burned toast that restores mana.
desc: Buttered, crunchy, and somehow enchanted. You are being fed by a corporation. Chew.
source: Free from the safe-room toaster, one per crawler (L6897)

name: Scroll of Heal Critter
book_effect: Heals a pet or critter.
desc: Meant for Mongo or any other animal that bites you. Read aloud, then step back.

name: Scroll of Confusing Fog
book_effect: Releases a confusing fog that blinds enemies; Carl used it to take out the Juicer.
desc: A fog that confuses everything in it, including you if you do not read the fine print.

name: Weapon Oil: Weeping Wound
book_effect: Coats a weapon so wounds keep bleeding for a while.
desc: A bottle of regret for your enemies. Wounds stay open and so does the hospital bill.

name: Crawler Biscuit
book_effect: Dry food for crawlers. Starting kits hand out them by the hundred, so they are not worth tracking.
desc: A cracker with delusions of being a meal. You get a hundred of them.

name: Pet Biscuit
book_effect: Treat for pets; Mongo loves them.
desc: Meant for Donut and Mongo. Do not try them yourself. You will want to.
source: Bronze Pet Box (L1039, x10; L1113, x500)

name: Enhanced Pet Biscuit
book_effect: Donut ate it and became sapient with huge stats; the game's turning point in book 1.
desc: One biscuit, one cat, one very large problem for everyone around her.

name: Goblin Dynamite
book_effect: Extremely volatile: loud noises can set it off. Keep it in the inventory until you throw it. Carl lights the wick with a lighter.
desc: Goblins carry it everywhere, next to the pineapples. Light, throw, and enjoy the surprise.
source: Starting kit x5, Silver Goblin Box x5 (L1085, L1937)

name: Lighter
book_effect: Lights dynamite wicks and torches.
desc: A tiny flame in a plastic body. Currently the most dangerous thing you own.

name: Goblin Smoke Bomb
book_effect: Deflagration; opaque smoke over a 10 meter radius for 3 minutes. Carl also used one to booby-trap a rat corpse.
desc: A cloud in a bottle. Useful for leaving, and for feelings you would rather not discuss.

name: Hobgoblin Pus
book_effect: A C4-like explosive that only goes off with a detonator, safer than dynamite.
desc: Shaped like a blob and named for a reason. It does nothing until you ask it to.

name: Detonator Trigger
book_effect: Looks like a stick of deodorant. Break off a tip, stick it in the explosive and press the button; single use, up to 10 pieces.
desc: One button, one use. A deodorant stick with a more exciting career.

name: Proximity Trigger
book_effect: Attached to a non-static trap using a Sapper's Table. Sets activation conditions: countdowns, mob-type triggers and more.
desc: Teach a trap to wait. It only goes off when the right person comes close.

name: Goo-Inator 3000
book_effect: A shaping tool, usable only at a workbench, that assists in reshaping materials. Keep the business end away from your face.
desc: A tool for turning one thing into another. Point away from face.

name: Gorgon Marital Aid
book_effect: A spatula-shaped crafting tool; the System makes jokes about its name.
desc: A spatula. We are not going to discuss the name.

name: Workbench (Engineer, Alchemy, Sapper)
book_effect: Indestructible crafting tables for engineering, alchemy and sapper work.
desc: Bolted down and loved by crafters. You cannot take it, but it will take your materials.

name: Carl's Jug O' Boom
book_effect: A moonshine jug turned into a thrown firebomb; the flames burn bodies, which also burn the loot.
desc: Carl's invention. It goes boom, which is the name, which is the instruction.
source: Invented by Carl from Rev-Up moonshine (around L5300)

name: Rev-Up Moonshine
book_effect: Toilet-grade moonshine sold by clurichauns; also the base for Carl's firebombs.
desc: Smells like an accident and tastes like a different accident.

name: Rev-Up Immunity Smoothie Recipe
book_effect: A two-ingredient recipe that grants immunity; Carl blended moonshine and a dead fairy on a bicycle blender.
desc: Two ingredients. The System admits it is gross and has shipped it anyway.

name: Goblin Pass
book_effect: A branded tattoo that stops goblins from attacking on sight; fairies hit harder.
desc: A tattoo-shaped permission slip. Goblins stop hating you on sight and start hating you on paperwork.
source: Silver Goblin Box (L1089), a tattoo on the forearm
notes: Only one Goblin Pass can ever be received per run. Loot tables skip it once owned or received.

name: Desperado Pass
book_effect: A tattoo pass for the Desperado Club; Carl's appeared on his neck and Donut's on her back.
desc: A ticket tattooed onto you, which is a lot of commitment for a nightclub.

name: Goblin Copper Chopper
book_effect: A steam-powered motorbike with an alligator-skull seat, coal hopper, relief valves and an orc-skull sidecar. Carl was later forced to abandon it.
desc: A bike that runs on coal and bad ideas. Fast, loud, and easy to lose.

name: Neighborhood Map
book_effect: Reveals about one square mile of the map and persists for the floor.
desc: A map the boss was carrying. The boss will not need it anymore.

name: Borough Field Guide
book_effect: Reveals mob levels in each quadrant of the borough.
desc: Know your monsters before they know you. Includes diagrams.

name: Tome of Magic Missile
book_effect: Teaches Magic Missile, fired from Donut's eyes; power is selectable at 3 to 6 mana.
desc: A spell book for cats who want laser eyes. Donut took it and has not looked back.

name: Tome of Wisp Armor
book_effect: Teaches Wisp Armor; costs 5 mana to cast. Carl could not cast it yet, so Donut took it.
desc: Wear a ghost as a coat. Costs more mana than you currently have.

name: Tome of Minion Army
book_effect: Teaches Minion Army: 50 mana, mind-controls a group of monsters. Too expensive to use at that level.
desc: Mind control for the whole room. Needs fifty mana you do not have.

name: Tome of Puddle Jumper
book_effect: Teaches Puddle Jumper, a short-range teleport that can bring up to three others along.
desc: Hop through a puddle and out of another. Moist but effective.

name: Tome of Second Chance
book_effect: Teaches Second Chance: 10 mana, raises a dead monster of lower level to fight for you for as many minutes as the spell's level.
desc: Raise the monster you just killed. It is not holding a grudge. It will not remember.
